content: ## Metadata_Start ## code: en ## title: Transaction Reattempt Notifications ## slug: payments-use-cases-transaction-reattempts ## seoTitle: Transaction Reattempts ## description: ## contentType: Markdown ## Metadata_End ## Failed Transaction Follow Up Automation When {{variable.Object_Transaction}}s fail and are reattempted, it is a good practice to follow up with the customer to notify them and update their card or bank account information if the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} continues to fail. :::(Info) () For the use case below, we will be creating a Process in Process Builder to send out an automated Email Alert to the customer on the second reattempt and then notify the Transaction owner via a Chatter Post on the third reattempt. ::: ## Step One - Create an Email Template and an Email Alert *These two records will be referenced later in {{variable.ProcessBuilder}}.* ### Create an Email Template 1. From Setup, navigate to: - Lightning: Email > Classic Email Templates - Classic: Administration Setup > Communication Templates > Classic Email Templates 2. Click **New Template** 3. Under "Choose the type of email template you would like to create," select "Text". 4. Click **Next**. 5. Under "Available Merge Fields" set {{variable.Field_ClassEmailTem_SelFieldTy}} = "Transaction Fields". :::(Warning) () Be sure to only use merge fields from the Transaction object for this template. Merged fields from other objects will not populate. ::: 6. Select the folder where you want to store your Email Template. 7. {{variable.Field_ClassicEmailTem_AvailUse}} checkbox should be checked 8. Enter an {{variable.Field_ClassicEmailTem_TempName}} and {{variable.Field_ClassicEmailTem_UniqName}}. 9. Enter a {{variable.Field_ClassicEmailTem_Descript}}. 10. Enter a {{variable.Field_ClassicEmailTemp_Subject}} and an {{variable.Field_ClassicEmailTem_EmailBod}} using a combination of text and {{variable.Object_Transaction}} merge fields ![G_01_03 reattempt notifications pic 1](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20reattempt%20notifications%20pic%201.png){height="" width=""} * * * ### Create an Email Alert 1. From Setup, navigate to: - Lightning: Process Automation > Workflow Actions > Email Alerts - Classic: Create > Workflow & Approvals > Email Alerts 2. Click {{variable.Button_NewEmailAlert}}. 3. Enter a {{variable.Field_NewEmailAlert_Descriptio}} and {{variable.Field_NewEmailAlert_UniqueName}}. 4. For {{variable.Field_NewEmailAlert_Object}}, select "Transaction". 5. For {{variable.Field_NewEmailAlert_EmailTempl}}, find and select your template from the prior step. :::(Warning) () If you cannot locate your Email Template, please go back to the Template and make sure `Available for Use` is checked. ::: 6. For {{variable.Field_NewEmailAlert_RecipiType}}, select "Email Field". 7. In the {{variable.Field_NewEmailAlert_AvailRecip}} column, select "Email Field: Payment Method Billing Email" and use the Add/Remove buttons to move the value into the {{variable.Field_NewEmailAlert_SelecRecip}} column. 8. If desired, enter any {{variable.Field_NewEmailAlert_AdditEmail}}. 9. Select the correct {{variable.Field_NewEmailAlert_FrEmailAdd}}. 10. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![G_01_03 reattempt notifications pic 2](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20reattempt%20notifications%20pic%202.png){height="" width=""} ## Step Two: Build the Process Using Process Builder Create a Process with the {{variable.ProcessBuilder}} to automatically send out an Email Alert to notify the Customer of a second reattempt, as well as post to Chatter to notify the {{variable.Object_Transaction}} owner after the third reattempt. ### Create a New Process 1. From Setup, navigate to: - Lightning: Process Automation > Process Builder - Classic: Create > Workflow & Approvals > Process Builder 2. Click {{variable.button_new}}. 3. Enter the {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ProcessName}}, {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_APIName}}, and {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Description}}. 4. Set {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ProcStartWh}} to "A record changes." ![G_01_03 reattempt notifications pic 3](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20reattempt%20notifications%20pic%203.png){height="" width=""} * * * ### Select the Object for the Process 1. On the canvas, click **Add Object**. 2. For the {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Object}} field, select "Transaction". 3. Under {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_StartTProce}}, select "when a record is created or edited". 4. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![G_01_03 reattempt notifications pic 4](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20reattempt%20notifications%20pic%204.png){height="" width=""} * * * ### Define the Criteria that Triggers the Process and Define your Actions #### Second Reattempt Criteria 1. On the canvas, click **+ Add Criteria**. 2. Enter the {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_CriteriName}}. 3. Set {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_CritExecAct}} to"Conditions are met". 4. Under Set Conditions, complete the following fields. - {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Field}} = "Reattempt Number" - {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Operator}} = "Equals" - {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Type}} = "Number" - {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Value}} = "2" 5. Set {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Conditions}} to "All of the conditions are met (AND)". 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![G_01_03 reattempt notifications pic 5](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20reattempt%20notifications%20pic%205.png){height="" width=""} #### Second Reattempt Action 1 1. On the canvas under IMMEDIATE ACTIONS, click **+ Add Action**. 2. For {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ActionType}}, select "Email Alerts". 3. Enter an {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ActionName}}. 4. Enter the {{variable.Workflow_EmailAlerts}} created in Step One in the {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_EmailAlert}} field. 5. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![G_01_03 reattempt notifications pic 6](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20reattempt%20notifications%20pic%206.png){height="" width=""} #### Third Reattempt Criteria 1. Under your last element on the canvas, click **+ Add Criteria**. 2. Enter the {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_CriteriName}}. 3. Under {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_CritExecAct}}, select "Conditions are Met". 4. Under Set Conditions, complete the following fields - {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Field}} = "Reattempt Number" - {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Operator}} = "Equals" - {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Type}} = "Number" - {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Value}} = "3" 5. Set {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Conditions}} to "All of the conditions are met (AND)". 6. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. ![G_01_03 reattempt notifications pic 7](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20reattempt%20notifications%20pic%207.png){height="" width=""} #### Third Reattempt Action 1 1. On the canvas under IMMEDIATE ACTIONS, click **+ Add Action**. 2. For {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ActionType}}, select "Post to Chatter". 3. Enter an {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_ActionName}}. 4. Under {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_PostTo}}, select "This Record". :::(Warning) (Feed Tracking) The "Post to Chatter" option is only visible if the feed for Transaction object is enabled. Setup > Search for Feed Tracking > Select Transaction > Enable Feed Tracking > Save. ::: 5. In the {{variable.Field_ProcessBuild_Message}} field, enter your custom message. *Example Message: @[{![bt_stripe__Transaction__c].OwnerId}] Contact the customer on this Transaction. Their Payment Method is incorrect and needs to be updated in order for the Transaction to process. An email has already been sent with a PayLink to update their Payment Method.* 7. Click {{variable.Button_Save}}. 8. Click **Activate**. ![G_01_03 reattempt notifications pic 8](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20reattempt%20notifications%20pic%208.png){height="" width=""} ![G_01_03 reattempt notifications pic 9](https://cdn.document360.io/f977eec0-500f-40a3-b663-724a51f78075/Images/Documentation/G_01_03%20reattempt%20notifications%20pic%209.png){height="" width=""} *On the third reattempt, a Chatter post will automatically be created and the Transaction owner notified.* ## Additional Use Cases If you have any suggestions for a use case with Blackthorn {{variable.Product_Payments}} please contact {{variable.Link_BlackthornSupport}} and provide details on your use case. We always appreciate hearing the solutions our customers create and love sharing that with our other customers!
